name: HERO11_camera_1_2p7K_60_SV_lrv
source_center_note: optimized by custom GoPro checkerboard reprojection fit
scale_px_per_model_unit_note: Average of x/y scale for backward compatibility. The actual remap code uses scale_x_px_per_model_unit and scale_y_px_per_model_unit.
undistortion_prescription: Use GoPro POLY/MAPX/MAPY with optimized source_cx/source_cy and scale_x/scale_y to remap raw GoPro pixels into the same-size rectilinear pinhole image defined by rectilinear_output_K.
rectilinear_output_K_source: canonical D&G K_out chosen by gopro_central_local_scale from the optimized GoPro source model
rectilinear_output_K_role: This is the K matrix of the undistorted rectilinear image. Use this exact K with Dumble-and-Gibbens after remapping horizon points/images through this model.
rectilinear_output_K_note: The final checkerboard calibration objective uses GoPro POLY/MAPX/MAPY directly, not OpenCV distortion coefficients. K_out defines the canonical undistorted pinhole image used by D&G.
D_and_G_usage: Use this model to remap raw GoPro pixels/images into the same-size rectilinear image, then use rectilinear_output_K as the Dumble-and-Gibbens K matrix.

scaled_model_info.scaling_note: K, source center, scale_x_px_per_model_unit, and scale_y_px_per_model_unit were scaled from the original calibration resolution. MAPX/MAPY/POLY/ZFOV/ZMPL were kept unchanged.
warnings: NOTE: lrv model says source_center_mode='image_center', but source_cx/source_cy are not exactly the nominal image center. I treated the saved source_cx/source_cy as the calibrated/optimized values and scaled them directly.
